title: Leader failover time
statement: The system shall elect a new shard leader and resume serving writes within 10 seconds (p99) of the current leader's node failing.
rationale: Bounds write unavailability per shard; no verified industry figure found.

acceptance_criteria.text: Across 100 leader-node kills in a 3-AZ cluster, p99 time from kill to first successful write on the affected shard is ≤ 10 s.
Configuration validation rejects election timeouts less than 10× the measured heartbeat round trip.

source: Research — PO to confirm 10 s bound
